description: Perpetual venues read directly (GMX, dYdX, Ostium, Veranta/Avantis): each venue’s exposure, collateral and accounts, every open GMX position counted, what attributable agents owe on lending markets, and how well prediction-market prices matched outcomes. The exposure figures are NOT one measurement (open interest on GMX, dYdX and Avantis; a summed floor on Ostium), so there is deliberately no total. FREE for the shape of each book; named positions are paid.
name: trading_venues

agentCredit.description: What attributable agents owe on lending markets; positions, largest and riskiest are paid.

gmx.description: GMX per chain: markets, open interest, liquidity, long and short; null where the reader has not run.

gmxAccounts.description: Every open GMX position summed: positions, size, collateral, leverage bands; the thinnest and attributable lists are paid (withheld names them).

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.
